drafted_from: tool:google-account-read_a_mail's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read message 18c1a2b3d4e5f888 in full. Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-read_a_mail as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "Read message 18c1a2b3d4e5f888 in full." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-read_a_mail, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"message_id":"18c1a2b3d4e5f888"}.
3. Read what comes back: the request goes as GET  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/messages/18c1a2b3d4e5f888?format=full.
4. Decode payload body data (base64url) to read the text; multipart messages hold one body per part.

worked_examples.title: Read one whole Gmail message on a sample input
worked_examples.given: read from tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (its invoke url, method and body_template) and checked against tools/read-and-write-gmail/test/rows.test.mjs. A message from sam@example.com with the plain-text body "Your bakery order is ready at 3 PM." The call it makes: GET the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/messages/18c1a2b3d4e5f888?format=full.
worked_examples.hands_back: Gmail answers an object whose fields the tool keeps as id "18c1a2b3d4e5f888" and payload {"mimeType":"text/plain","headers":[{"name":"From","value":"sam@example.com"},{"name":"Subject","value":"Order pickup"}],"body":{"size":35,"data":"WW91ciBiYWtlcnkgb3JkZXIgaXMgcmVhZHkgYXQgMyBQTS4"}}. The body data is base64url; decode it to read the words.
